assessment.security_status_en: The United States faces escalating tensions ahead of the upcoming midterms, accompanied by bitter political clashes, election interference allegations, and security incidents including facility evacuations and raids. Simultaneously, geopolitical friction intensifies in the Middle East as the US pulls non-emergency staff from Saudi Arabia amid regional strikes. Domestic economic debates remain focused on affordability, energy policy, and widening political polarization.

president_comments.statement_cs: Prezident Trump popřel, že by nařídil zpomalení sítě Starlink na Ukrajině, a uvedl, že o tom, kdo za tím stojí, nic neví.

president_comments.topic_cs: Prezident Trump otevřeně pochválil účastníka své rally v Jižní Karolíně za to, že údajně udeřil protestujícího.

president_comments.comment_cs: Oslavování fyzického násilí na politických shromážděních zvyšuje obavy z růstu domácího napětí a polarizace před volbami.
president_comments.comment_en: Glorifying physical violence at political rallies heightens concerns over rising domestic tension and polarization ahead of the elections.

president_comments.statement_cs: President Trump stated that data centers should generate their own electricity, though experts point out that only states can mandate that.

president_comments.comment_en: This proposal highlights growing pressure on the power grid amid the AI boom, though it runs up against the jurisdictional limits of federal authority.
